executiveAssessment.text: Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo currently shows AI Consideration of 29.0% and Scenario Presence of 42.9%, with Reality Coverage at 50.0%. Strongest governed signal: Still developing. Primary constraint: Competitors appear when this hotel does not. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +29.0 pp and Scenario Presence +42.9 pp. Independent Positioning metrics are included only where published. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.
